about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, an established Corporate Service Provider in Malta that offers corporate, accounting, taxation and business advisory services to local and international clients. The company is looking for a qualified Accountant with a valid warrant to join its team in Gozo.

You will take responsibility for a diverse portfolio of corporate clients: overseeing their bookkeeping, preparing and reviewing management accounts and annual financial statements, handling VAT and tax returns, and making sure every statutory deadline is met. You will also be the clients' point of contact for accounting, tax and reporting questions and will coordinate with external auditors.

This full-time, on-site role suits a warrant-holding accountant with Corporate Service Provider experience who already lives in Gozo. Only candidates currently residing in Gozo will be considered. The salary is €37,000–€45,000 per year.
responsibilities: Manage and oversee accounting activities for a portfolio of corporate clients
Prepare and review management accounts and annual financial statements
Oversee bookkeeping activities and ensure the accuracy of accounting records and reconciliations
Prepare and review VAT and tax returns, ensuring timely and accurate submissions
Ensure clients comply with applicable accounting standards, tax legislation and statutory requirements
Liaise with clients regarding their accounting, taxation and financial reporting requirements
Coordinate with external auditors and help prepare the documentation required for audits
Monitor regulatory and statutory deadlines so that all submissions are completed on time
Provide accounting and financial guidance to clients when required
Assist the management team with accounting-related matters, projects and other business activities

faq: What does the Accountant in Gozo do?

You manage the accounting for a portfolio of corporate clients: overseeing bookkeeping, preparing and reviewing management accounts, annual financial statements and VAT and tax returns, and liaising with clients and external auditors.
Do I need an accountancy warrant?
Yes. A valid Accountancy Warrant (CPA or CPAA) is essential, together with a relevant degree or equivalent professional qualification in Accountancy.
Is Corporate Service Provider experience required?
Yes. Previous experience within a Corporate Service Provider (CSP) is essential, along with good knowledge of Maltese accounting, taxation and VAT requirements.
What is the salary for this Accountant job?
The salary is €37,000–€45,000 per year for this full-time, on-site role in Gozo.
Can I apply if I live in Malta but not in Gozo?
No. Only candidates currently residing in Gozo will be considered, and fluency in both Maltese and English is essential.
Apply online through the form on this page. Outreach Recruitment aims to respond to all applications within 3–5 business days.
